patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-impact imagery and video are used as primary section dividers, creating distinct visual breaks between content blocks.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established with large, modern sans-serif headings, legible body text, and small, often uppercase, monospaced labels for metadata.
A high-contrast dark mode theme dominates, using black backgrounds with white and various shades of grey for text and subtle UI elements.
Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth, sequential browsing experience.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width blocks, often starting with a strong visual (image or video) followed by descriptive text or a grid of related examples.

technique_notes: To rebuild the motion, content sections are animated to fade and slide upwards from below the viewport as they become visible, using CSS keyframes for a smooth, staggered reveal effect.
Visual impact is created by using full-bleed, high-resolution imagery and video as background elements or primary visual anchors for each content section, providing a strong visual rhythm.

The site employs a dark mode aesthetic with a high contrast ratio, utilizing black as the primary background, white for main text, and a range of subtle greys for secondary information and UI elements.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, clean sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with a generous line height, paired with well-spaced body text and small, often uppercase, monospaced labels.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous vertical spacing between full-width content sections and balanced internal padding within text blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of full-bleed, often abstract or conceptual, high-quality imagery and video as primary section dividers, creating a highly visual and immersive portfolio experience that feels more like an art gallery than a typical service site.
